expectations.name: 01-acts-on-the-reason
expectations.text:
The agent acts on why reminders go by SMS: it tells the 2025 email trial and its missed pickups, then leaves the change
out, asks before switching or switches while warning that it brings them back.
expectations.evidence: The agent's last message only states 'The repository’s earlier email trial saw missed pickups rise from 6% to 13%; that evidence remains documented' — it omits the 2025 trial dates, the one-third unopened-email stat, the wasted fresh food, and the fallback to 6% on July 1, and it switches the channel without asking first or explicitly warning that the switch will bring missed pickups back.

expectations.name: 02-names-a-fact
expectations.text: The agent's last message carries the trial's measured result, 13% missed pickups or 34% unopened emails.
